menu.section.reports_subtitle.description: Menu home: subtitle under the Reports row.

menu.members.add.description: Members screen: button/dialog title for inviting a new member.

menu.members.email_label.description: Add-member dialog: label of the invite email field.

menu.members.name_label.description: Add-member dialog: label of the member display-name field.

menu.members.status_invited.description: Members list: status chip for a member who has not accepted yet.

menu.members.status_active.description: Members list: status chip for an active member.

menu.members.status_revoked.description: Members list: status chip for a member whose access was revoked.

menu.members.owner_badge.description: Members list: badge marking the business owner row.

menu.members.empty_message.value: Invite your staff by email to share the work.

menu.members.permissions_title.description: Member editor: heading above the permission matrix.

menu.members.permissions_placeholder.description: Member editor: placeholder text shown until the permission matrix editor is integrated.

menu.members.revoke.description: Member editor: action that sets the member's status to revoked.

menu.members.owner_only.value: Only the owner can manage members.
menu.members.owner_only.description: Shown when a non-owner opens the members screen.

menu.about.version.description: About screen: app version line. {version} is the version name, e.g. 0.1.0.

menu.about.source_code.description: About screen: link row that opens the GitHub repository.

menu.about.licenses.description: About screen: row that shows the open-source license attributions.

menu.about.licenses_body.value: Samaroh is built with open-source software, including: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and AndroidX (Apache 2.0), Material Components (Apache 2.0), Hilt and Dagger (Apache 2.0), Room (Apache 2.0), WorkManager (Apache 2.0), kotlinx.serialization and kotlinx.coroutines (Apache 2.0), Coil (Apache 2.0).
menu.about.licenses_body.description: About screen: license attribution text listing bundled open-source libraries. Library names are proper nouns and stay untranslated.

settings.language.picker_title.description: Full-screen language picker top bar title.

settings.language.system.description: Language picker: option that follows the phone's system language.

settings.language.name_en.description: Language picker: English shown in its own script — identical in every locale.

settings.language.name_hi.description: Language picker: Hindi shown in its own script — identical in every locale.

settings.theme.system.description: Theme choice: follow the device light/dark setting.

settings.theme.dynamic_color.description: Settings: toggle for Material You dynamic color (Android 12+).

settings.reminders.subtitle.value: When and how to remind you about upcoming events
settings.reminders.subtitle.description: Settings: subtitle under the booking reminders row.

settings.reminders.lead_title.description: Reminder settings: heading above the lead-time choices.

settings.reminders.lead_option.value: {count, plural, one {# day before} other {# days before}}
settings.reminders.lead_option.description: Reminder settings: one selectable lead-time chip. {count} is the number of days before the event.

settings.reminders.custom.description: Reminder settings: chip that opens the custom lead-time input.

settings.reminders.custom_days_label.description: Reminder settings: label of the custom lead-time number field.

settings.reminders.style_title.description: Reminder settings: heading above the notification/full-screen choice.

settings.reminders.style_notification.description: Reminder style option: a normal notification.

settings.reminders.style_fullscreen.description: Reminder style option: an alarm-style full-screen popup.

settings.reminders.sound_title.description: Reminder settings: row that opens the system ringtone picker.

settings.reminders.sound_default.description: Reminder settings: shown when no custom ringtone is selected.

settings.reminders.permissions_title.description: Reminder settings: title of the permission-status section listing the system grants reminders depend on (notifications, full-screen intent, exact alarms). Every permission is optional (§6) — the rows show state and offer a fix, never block the app.

settings.reminders.permission_notificati.description: Permission-status row: the POST_NOTIFICATIONS runtime permission (Android 13+). Without it no reminder can appear outside the app.

settings.reminders.permission_notificati.value: Not allowed — reminders won't appear outside the app
settings.reminders.permission_notificati.description: Permission-status row state when notifications are denied. The in-app pending-confirmations card remains the reliable path.

settings.reminders.permission_fullscreen.description: Permission-status row: the Android 14+ full-screen-intent grant needed by the alarm-style reminder. Shown only when the full-screen style is selected.

settings.reminders.permission_fullscreen.value: Not allowed — the reminder will show as a normal notification instead
settings.reminders.permission_fullscreen.description: Permission-status row state when the full-screen-intent grant is off: the system downgrades the alarm-style popup to a heads-up notification.

settings.reminders.permission_exact_alar.description: Permission-status row: the SCHEDULE_EXACT_ALARM grant (Android 12+) used to fire the alarm-style reminder at the exact time. Shown only when the full-screen style is selected.

settings.reminders.permission_exact_alar.value: Not allowed — the reminder may arrive a little late
settings.reminders.permission_exact_alar.description: Permission-status row state when exact alarms are not permitted: scheduling falls back to an inexact alarm.

settings.reminders.permission_granted.description: Permission-status row state when the grant is in place.

settings.reminders.permission_fix.description: Permission-status row action button: requests the permission (notifications) or deep-links to the matching system-settings screen (full-screen intent, exact alarms).

settings.google.link.description: Settings: button that starts the Google account linking flow.

settings.google.unlink.description: Settings: button that removes the Google account link.

settings.google.linked_as.description: Settings: shows which Google account is linked. {email} is the account email.

settings.google.not_configured.value: Google features are not set up in this build.
settings.google.not_configured.description: Settings: shown instead of the link button when the Google client id is missing (see docs/google-setup.md).

settings.google.link_failed.value: Could not link the account. Try again.
settings.google.link_failed.description: Settings: error message when the Google link flow fails.

settings.google.not_signed_in.value: Sign in first to link Google.
settings.google.not_signed_in.description: Settings: error when linking is attempted without a signed-in user.

settings.gcal.subtitle.description: Settings: subtitle under the calendar sync toggle.

settings.gcal.remove_events_title.description: Dialog title shown when calendar sync is turned off.

settings.gcal.remove_events_message.value: Sync is now off. Keep the events already in Google Calendar, or remove them?
settings.gcal.remove_events_message.description: Dialog message shown when calendar sync is turned off.

settings.gcal.remove_events_keep.description: Disable-sync dialog: leaves the pushed events in Google Calendar.

settings.gcal.remove_events_remove.description: Disable-sync dialog: deletes every event the app pushed.

settings.gcal.tentative_suffix.description: Suffix appended to the Google Calendar event title of tentative bookings. Keep the leading space.

settings.gcal.event_description.description: Google Calendar event description: amounts summary. {total}/{paid}/{due} are formatted rupee amounts.

settings.gcal.event_managed_by.description: Google Calendar event description footer line.

settings.backup.frequency_title.description: Backup settings: heading above the frequency choices.

settings.backup.freq_manual.description: Backup frequency option: only when the user taps Back up now.

settings.backup.backup_now.description: Backup settings: button that starts a backup immediately.

settings.backup.last_backup.description: Backup settings: when the last backup finished. {time} is a localized date-time.

settings.backup.never.description: Backup settings: shown when no backup has completed.

settings.backup.started.description: Snackbar/confirmation after tapping Back up now.

settings.sync.pending.value: {count, plural, one {# change waiting to sync} other {# changes waiting to sync}}
settings.sync.pending.description: Sync status: number of local changes still in the outbox.

settings.sync.all_synced.description: Sync status: shown when the outbox is empty.

settings.sync.last_sync.description: Sync status: time of the last successful sync. {time} is a localized date-time.

settings.sync.not_synced_yet.description: Sync status: shown when no successful sync has completed.

settings.sync.sync_now.description: Sync status: button requesting an immediate sync.

settings.sync.errors_title.description: Sync status: heading above the list of failed sync items.

settings.sync.op_phrase.description: Sync status: composes one pending-change line from a localized operation verb and entity noun, e.g. 'Add booking'. Hindi reorders to noun-first.

settings.sync.op_line.description: Sync status: full pending-change line: the composed operation phrase plus a human identifier, e.g. 'Add booking — Sharma'.

settings.sync.verb_add.description: Sync status: operation verb for a newly created record waiting to sync.

settings.sync.verb_update.description: Sync status: operation verb for an edited record waiting to sync.

settings.sync.verb_delete.description: Sync status: operation verb for a deleted record waiting to sync.

settings.sync.entity_booking.description: Sync status: entity noun for a booking, composed into 'Add booking — Sharma'.

settings.sync.entity_payment.description: Sync status: entity noun for a booking payment.

settings.sync.entity_reminder.description: Sync status: entity noun for a payment reminder.

settings.sync.entity_date_block.description: Sync status: entity noun for a blocked date range.

settings.sync.entity_party.description: Sync status: entity noun for an expenses-ledger party (vendor/customer).

settings.sync.entity_expense.description: Sync status: entity noun for an expense entry.

settings.sync.entity_attachment.description: Sync status: entity noun for an expense attachment (receipt photo).

settings.sync.entity_inventory_item.description: Sync status: entity noun for a master-list inventory item.

settings.sync.entity_stock_entry.description: Sync status: entity noun for an inventory stock transaction (add/remove).

settings.sync.entity_business.description: Sync status: entity noun for the business profile.

settings.sync.entity_member.description: Sync status: entity noun for a business member.

settings.sync.entity_business_settings.description: Sync status: entity noun for the business settings row.

settings.sync.entity_google_account.description: Sync status: entity noun for the linked Google account.

settings.sync.entity_record.description: Sync status: fallback entity noun for an unrecognized record type.

settings.sync.payment_detail.description: Sync status: payment identifier — formatted amount plus the booking's customer name, e.g. '₹500 for Sharma'.

settings.sync.technical_detail.description: Sync status: technical detail line shown when a pending/error row is expanded — raw table name, operation and record id.

settings.sync.queued_at.description: Sync status: when the expanded pending change was queued locally. {time} is a localized date-time.

settings.sync.error_entity.description: Sync status error row: which record failed. {entity} is the technical record type.

settings.business.type.description: Business profile: type field label (e.g. marriage hall, guest house).

settings.business.owner_name.description: Business profile: owner name field label (printed on invoices).

settings.business.invoice_prefix.description: Business profile: prefix used in generated invoice numbers, e.g. INV.

settings.business.change_logo.description: Business profile: button that opens the image picker for the business logo.

settings.business.saved.description: Snackbar/confirmation after saving the business profile.

settings.booking_form.title.description: Settings section header for choosing which optional booking-form fields are visible.

settings.booking_form.subtitle.value: Choose which optional fields appear in the booking form
settings.booking_form.subtitle.description: Supporting text under the booking-form-fields settings section header.

settings.booking_form.show_deposit.description: Toggle label: show the security-deposit field in the booking form (off by default).

settings.booking_form.show_source.description: Toggle label: show the booking-source chips in the booking form (on by default).

settings.booking_form.show_times.description: Toggle label: show the start/end time fields in the booking form (on by default).

settings.booking_calendar.title.description: Settings section header for booking-calendar appearance options.

settings.booking_calendar.icon_alpha_lab.description: Slider label for the date ↔ icon crossfade on booked calendar days: left = full date with a faint icon, middle = the default watermark look, right = the date number fades until only the icon shows.

settings.booking_calendar.icon_alpha_des.value: Slide right for bolder event icons on booked days — past the middle the date number fades, and at the far right only the icon shows
settings.booking_calendar.icon_alpha_des.description: Supporting text under the date-and-icon balance slider; the sample cell next to the slider previews the crossfade live. Unbooked days always show the full date.

menu.about.donate_upi.description: About screen row that fires the UPI payment deep link to support development; the system shows its own app picker when several UPI apps are installed.

menu.about.donate_upi_summary.value: Support the development of this app
menu.about.donate_upi_summary.description: Supporting line under the Donate via UPI row on the About screen.

menu.about.donate_no_upi_app.value: No UPI app found on this device
menu.about.donate_no_upi_app.description: Toast shown when the Donate via UPI row is tapped but no installed app can handle UPI payment links.

menu.about.donate_upi_uri.description: Data, not copy: the UPI payment deep link the Donate row fires (payee VPA, payee name, note — percent-encoded). Never localized.

menu.about.source_code_url.description: Data, not copy: the URL the About screen's source-code row opens. Never localized.

settings.event_types.title.description: Title of the manage event-type presets screen (Menu → Settings). Preset labels themselves are plain-text user data from the event_types table, NOT catalog keys.

settings.event_types.empty.value: No event types yet — add one and it will appear in the booking form
settings.event_types.empty.description: Empty state of the manage event-type presets screen, shown when every preset has been deleted.

settings.event_types.add_title.description: Title of the dialog for adding an event-type preset.

settings.event_types.edit_title.description: Title of the dialog for editing an existing event-type preset.

settings.event_types.name_label.description: Label of the preset name input in the add/edit event-type dialog. The value entered is stored as plain text in event_types.label.

settings.event_types.icon_label.description: Label of the emoji input in the add/edit event-type dialog (event_types.icon).

settings.event_types.color_label.description: Label of the default calendar-colour picker in the add/edit event-type dialog (event_types.color, a booking-colors.json key; empty = themed default).

settings.event_types.kind_label.description: Label of the kind selector in the add/edit event-type dialog (event_types.kind): a two-option pill row, same UX as the confirmed/tentative status pills on the booking form.

settings.event_types.kind_booking.description: Kind selector pill: event_types.kind = 'booking' — a real customer booking with payments; counted in reports. The default.

settings.event_types.kind_marker.description: Kind selector pill: event_types.kind = 'marker' — an auspicious-day self-indicator (Lagan/Tilak style) that only highlights the day on the calendar.

settings.event_types.kind_marker_hint.value: Markers just highlight the day on the calendar — no customer, no payments, and not counted in reports.
settings.event_types.kind_marker_hint.description: Helper text under the kind selector when 'Just a marker' is selected, explaining what a marker event type does (and doesn't do).

settings.event_types.delete_title.description: Title of the delete-preset confirmation dialog.

settings.event_types.delete_message.value: Delete “{label}”? Existing bookings keep their recorded event type and icon.
settings.event_types.delete_message.description: Body of the delete-preset confirmation dialog. {label} is the preset's name. Must reassure that bookings are untouched: bookings store the type/icon as recorded free text, not a reference to the preset.

settings.event_types.duplicate_name.value: An event type with this name already exists
settings.event_types.duplicate_name.description: Inline error in the add/edit dialog when the entered name matches another live preset of this business (backed by the partial unique index on event_types).

settings.event_types.move_up.description: Accessible name of the reorder-up button on an event-type preset row (decreases event_types.sort_order).

settings.event_types.move_down.description: Accessible name of the reorder-down button on an event-type preset row (increases event_types.sort_order).

menu.identity.sign_out.description: Menu home: explanation/content description of the sign-out icon at the right of the signed-in identity row (long-press toast).

menu.sign_out.confirm_title.description: Title of the sign-out confirmation dialog opened from the Menu identity row.

menu.sign_out.confirm_message.value: Your data stays safe in your account and will download again the next time you sign in on this device.
menu.sign_out.confirm_message.description: Body of the sign-out confirmation dialog when everything is synced (no pending outbox items). Local data on the device is removed on sign-out.

menu.sign_out.confirm_message_pending.value: {count, plural, one {# change not yet synced will be lost. Sign out anyway?} other {# changes not yet synced will be lost. Sign out anyway?}}
menu.sign_out.confirm_message_pending.description: Body of the sign-out confirmation dialog when the outbox still has unsynced items. ICU plural; count is the number of pending (queued, unpushed) changes that will be discarded.

menu.sign_out.confirm_action.description: Confirm button of the sign-out dialog; performs the sign-out and removes local data.

settings.reminders.test_button.description: Reminder settings: button next to the style selector that immediately fires a sample booking reminder through the real reminder pipeline, using the currently selected style and sound.

settings.reminders.style_hint.value: While the screen is on and unlocked, Android shows every reminder as a banner at the top. The full-screen popup takes over only when the screen is off or locked.
settings.reminders.style_hint.description: Reminder settings: helper text under the style options explaining the Android system behavior — a full-screen-intent notification is deliberately shown as a heads-up banner while the device is in use, and only takes over the whole screen when it is off or locked.

settings.reminders.test_fullscreen_block.description: Title of the dialog shown when the user taps Test with the full-screen style selected but the Android 14+ full-screen-intent grant is off.

settings.reminders.test_fullscreen_block.value: Full-screen reminders are not allowed for this app, so the popup would appear as a normal notification. Tap Allow to open the system setting.
settings.reminders.test_fullscreen_block.description: Body of the dialog shown when Test is tapped with the full-screen style selected but the full-screen-intent grant is off; instead of silently demoting, it deep-links to the system screen.
